objective: Combine semantic embedding retrieval with domain/intent classification and complementary multi-lesson selection without tuning on V01-V06.

stages.name: CLASSIFY
stages.rule: Infer one or more plausible domains and question types before semantic ranking.

stages.name: EMBED
stages.rule: Rank all lessons by semantic similarity; similarity is a routing signal only.

stages.name: HYBRID_SCORE
stages.rule: Combine semantic score with domain/type compatibility; explicit intent outranks lexical similarity.

stages.name: COMPLEMENT
stages.rule: Select a small set of non-redundant lessons covering distinct useful roles.

stages.name: DEPENDENCY_DEDUP
stages.rule: Collapse duplicate or same-purpose strategies before injection.

stages.name: CONFLICT_GATE
stages.rule: Preserve incompatible assumptions and do not silently fuse them.

evaluation.promotion_gate: V2 must improve cold routing utility without increasing critical irrelevant injections.
